title: ChatRagLookupRequest
description: Direct retrieval request for validating RAG chunk lookup in chat.

query.description: Free-form user query sent to the retrieval service.

topK.description: Optional number of chunks to retrieve. Service defaults/caps apply.

collections.description: Required target Weaviate classes to search for retrieval.

collectionFilters.description: Optional collection-scoped metadata filters forwarded to rag-service.
